		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-weight:bold;">Loans</font><font style="display:inline;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;"> &#x2014; The fair value of&nbsp;loans is estimated by discounting future&nbsp;contractual cash flows using estimated market&nbsp;rates at which similar loans would be made to borrowers with similar credit ratings and for the same remaining maturities.&nbsp;&nbsp;In computing the estimate of fair value for all loans, the estimated cash flows and/or carrying value have been reduced by specific and general reserves for loan losses. The fair value of loans disclosed in the table above, which is not the exit price, is classified as Level 3 within the fair value hierarchy.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-weight:bold;">Accrued Interest Receivable/Payable</font><font style="display:inline;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;"> &#x2014; The fair value of accrued interest receivable/payable approximates the carrying amount due to the short-term nature of these amounts and is classified in the same level hierarchy as the underlying assets/liabilities.&nbsp; </font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-weight:bold;">Deposits</font><font style="display:inline;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;"> &#x2014; The fair value of certificates of deposit is estimated by discounting the expected life using an index of the U.S. Treasury curve. Non-maturity deposits are reflected at their carrying value for purposes of estimating fair value. The fair value of all deposits is classified as Level 2.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-weight:bold;">Securities Sold Under Agreements to Repurchase</font><font style="display:inline;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;"> &#x2014; Estimated fair value is based on discounting cash flows and is classified as Level 2.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-weight:bold;">Short-Term Borrowings</font><font style="display:inline;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;"> &#x2014; The estimated fair value of short-term borrowings approximates their carrying value, due to their short-term nature and is classified as Level 2.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-weight:bold;">Subordinated Notes Payable</font><font style="display:inline;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;"> &#x2014; The estimated fair value of subordinated notes payable is based on discounting cash flows for comparable instruments and is classified as Level 3.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-weight:bold;">Junior Subordinated Debentures</font><font style="display:inline;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;"> &#x2014; The estimated fair value of junior subordinated debentures approximates their carrying value, due to the variable interest rate paid on the debentures and is classified as Level 2.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman,Times,serif;font-size: 10pt;">
			<font style="display:inline;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-weight:bold;">Commitments to Extend Credit and Standby Letters of Credit</font><font style="display:inline;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;"> &#x2014; The Company&#x2019;s off-balance sheet commitments are funded at current market rates at the date they are drawn upon. It is management&#x2019;s opinion that the fair value of these commitments would approximate their carrying value, if drawn upon, and are classified as Level 3.</font>
		</p>

			<font style="display:inline;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">&nbsp;</font>

			<font style="display:inline;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">The fair value estimates presented herein are based on pertinent information available to management at December&nbsp;31,&nbsp;2017 and 2016. Although management is not aware of any factors that would significantly affect the estimated fair value amounts, such amounts have not been comprehensively revalued for purposes of these financial statements since that date and, therefore, current estimates of fair value may differ significantly from the amounts presented herein.</font>

			<font style="display:inline;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-size:10pt;">The Fee-Based Lines segment consists of businesses offering products and services that are financial in nature and for which revenues are based on a percentage of an underlying basis such as managed assets or paid premiums.&nbsp;&nbsp;Activities in this segment include investment advisory through CoBiz Wealth, LLC and insurance brokerage through CoBiz Insurance, Inc.&nbsp;&nbsp;CoBiz Wealth, LLC provides investment management advisory services to affluent individuals, families and businesses.&nbsp;&nbsp;CoBiz Insurance, Inc. offers property and casualty (P&amp;C) and employee benefit group insurance (EB) broker agency to small to mid-sized employers, commercial enterprises and individual lines to their owners.&nbsp; </font>
